why: A board with no destructibles has no destructible share, so the list of boards over 30% of their wall mass empties and reads as the criterion met by a generator that had stopped drawing any. The population has to carry destructibles to count, or the exception list is vacuous.
killedBy: runs: destructibles over 30% of the wall mass, listed by seed (issue #1029) lists the default boards over 30% of their wall cells for seeds 1-100, by seed and share
